preconditions: Zero or more exact contact evidence-hull coverage records
decisionLogic: Union original route vertices with every exact support-interval endpoint.
Verify every supplied endpoint lies on its declared route segment.
Merge coincident stations only within an explicit numerical tolerance.
Leave terrain elevation empty until directly sampled from a hash-bound DEM artifact.
outputs: optional direct XYZ DEM completion at every planned station
uncertainty: Merge tolerance is numerical only and does not authorize terrain or geological interpolation
exclusions: No invented elevation at inserted support boundaries
validationMethod: Multiple coincident boundaries, direct DEM completion, station mismatch, bad hash and off-route endpoint tests
reopenCondition: Continuous raster sampler callbacks or curved/geodesic route primitives are introduced
